info.title: Shopify REST Admin API 2026-10 (agent contract, legacy)
info.description: Legacy REST API. Shopify adds no new features here and requires new public apps to use GraphQL (see specs/shopify/graphql). Use these endpoints only for simple reads/writes already in use; transfers, shipments and product writes are GraphQL-only. Generated from Shopify's REST reference pages by scripts/build_shopify_rest.py; schemas are inferred from documented examples.

email.description: The unique email address of the customer. Attempting to assign the same email address to multiple customers returns an error.

company.description: Always null in Shopify's documented examples; type not documented.

The default address has the following properties: * **address1**: The first line of the customer's mailing address. * **address2**: An additional field for the customer's mailing address. * **city**: The customer's city, town, or village. * **company**: The customer's company. * **country**: The customer's country. * **country\_code**: The two-letter country c

id.description: The ID of the gift card.

balance.description: The balance of the gift card.

created_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the gift card was created.

currency.description: The currency of the gift card.

initial_value.description: The initial value of the gift card when it was created.

disabled_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the gift card was disabled.

line_item_id.description: The ID of the line item that initiated the creation of this gift card, if it was created by an order. Passing this parameter no longer creates a fulfillment; it only records the line item on the gift card. Use the GraphQL fulfillmentCreate mutation to fulfill order line items instead.

api_client_id.description: The ID of the client that issued the gift card.

user_id.description: Always null in Shopify's documented examples; type not documented.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer associated with this gift card.

expires_on.description: The date (`YYYY-MM-DD` format) when the gift card expires. Returns `null` if the gift card doesn't have an expiration date.

last_characters.description: The last four characters of the gift card code. Because gift cards are alternative payment methods, the full code cannot be retrieved.

order_id.description: Always null in Shopify's documented examples; type not documented.

code.description: The gift card code, which is a string of alphanumeric characters. For security reasons, this is available only upon creation of the gift card. (minimum: 8 characters, maximum: 20 characters)

id.description: A unique numeric identifier for the product image.

alt.description: Always null in Shopify's documented examples; type not documented.

position.description: The order of the product image in the list. The first product image is at position 1 and is the "main" image for the product.

product_id.description: The id of the product associated with the image.

created_at.description: The date and time when the product image was created. The API returns this value in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the product image was last modified. The API returns this value in ISO 8601 format.

width.description: Width dimension of the image which is determined on upload.

height.description: Height dimension of the image which is determined on upload.

src.description: Specifies the location of the product image. This parameter supports Liquid filters that you can use to retrieve modified copies of the image.

variant_ids.description: An array of variant ids associated with the image.

id.description: The ID of the inventory item.

sku.description: The unique SKU (stock keeping unit) of the inventory item. Case-sensitive string.

created_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory item was created.

updated_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory item was last modified.

requires_shipping.description: Whether a customer needs to provide a shipping address when placing an order containing the inventory item.

cost.description: The unit cost of the inventory item. The shop's default currency is used.

country_code_of_origin.description: The country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) of where the item came from.

province_code_of_origin.description: The province code (ISO 3166-2 alpha-2) of where the item came from. The province code is only used if the shipping provider for the inventory item is Canada Post.

harmonized_system_code.description: The general Harmonized System (HS) code for the inventory item. Used if a country-specific HS code (`countryHarmonizedSystemCode`) is not available.

tracked.description: Whether inventory levels are tracked for the item. If true, then the inventory quantity changes are tracked by Shopify.

country_harmonized_system_codes.description: An array of country-specific Harmonized System (HS) codes for the item. Used to determine duties when shipping the inventory item to certain countries.

inventory_item_id.description: The ID of the inventory item associated with the inventory level. To find the ID of an inventory item, use the Inventory Item resource

location_id.description: The ID of the location that the inventory level belongs to. To find the ID of the location, use the Location resource

available.description: The available quantity of an inventory item at the inventory level's associated location. Returns `null` if the inventory item is not tracked.

updated_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the inventory level was last modified.

address2.description: The optional second line of the location's street address.

city.description: The city the location is in.

province.description: The province, state, or district of the location.

country.description: The country the location is in.

phone.description: The phone number of the location. This value can contain special characters, such as `-` or `+`.

created_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the location was created.

country_code.description: The two-letter code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format) corresponding to country the location is in.

legacy.description: Whether this is a fulfillment service location. If `true`, then the location is a fulfillment service location. If `false`, then the location was created by the merchant and isn't tied to a fulfillment service.

active.description: Whether the location is active. If `true`, then the location can be used to sell products, stock inventory, and fulfill orders. Merchants can deactivate locations from the Shopify admin. Deactivated locations don't contribute to the shop's location limit.

app_id.description: The ID of the app that created the order.

browser_ip.description: The IP address of the browser used by the customer when they placed the order. Both IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

buyer_accepts_marketing.description: Whether the customer consented to receive email updates from the shop.

cancel_reason.description: The reason why the order was canceled. Valid values: * **customer**: The customer canceled the order. * **fraud**: The order was fraudulent. * **inventory**: Items in the order were not in inventory. * **declined**: The payment was declined. * **other**: A reason not in this list.

cancelled_at.description: The date and time when the order was canceled. Returns `null` if the order isn't canceled.

cart_token.description: A unique value when referencing the cart that's associated with the order.

checkout_token.description: A unique value when referencing the checkout that's associated with the order.

accept_language.description: Always null in Shopify's documented examples; type not documented.

browser_height.description: Always null in Shopify's documented examples; type not documented.

session_hash.description: Always null in Shopify's documented examples; type not documented.

user_agent.description: Always null in Shopify's documented examples; type not documented.

confirmation_number.description: A randomly generated alpha-numeric identifier for the order that may be shown to the customer instead of the sequential order name. This value isn't guaranteed to be unique.

id.description: An unsigned 64-bit integer that's used as a unique identifier for the product. Each `id` is unique across the Shopify system. No two products will have the same `id`, even if they're from different shops.

body_html.description: A description of the product. Supports HTML formatting.

product_type.description: A categorization for the product used for filtering and searching products.

created_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the product was created.

handle.description: A unique human-friendly string for the product. Automatically generated from the product's `title`. Used by the Liquid templating language to refer to objects.

published_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the product was published. Can be set to `null` to unpublish the product from the Online Store channel.

template_suffix.description: The suffix of the Liquid template used for the product page. If this property is specified, then the product page uses a template called "product.suffix.liquid", where "suffix" is the value of this property. If this property is \<code>"" or `null`, then the product page uses the default template "product.liquid". (default: `null`)

published_scope.description: Whether the product is published to the Point of Sale channel. Valid values: * `web`: The product isn't published to the Point of Sale channel. * `global`: The product is published to the Point of Sale channel.

tags.description: A string of comma-separated tags that are used for filtering and search. A product can have up to 250 tags. Each tag can have up to 255 characters.

status.description: The status of the product. Valid values: * `active`: The product is ready to sell and is available to customers on the online store, sales channels, and apps.
